image_description: A white and blue electric steam iron positioned diagonally on a plain white background. The iron features a glossy plastic body, a visible temperature dial on the top handle, a translucent blue water tank section, and a metallic soleplate with a pointed tip. A white power cord extends from the rear heel of the iron.

The power cord merges into the plastic body without a clear strain relief boot or distinct connector housing, appearing to fuse slightly with the casing.
The markings on the temperature dial are indistinct and seem to warp slightly with the curvature of the handle, lacking crisp typography.
